Manage Bronto credentials and profiles

:::tip[Learn more]
The Bronto docs explain the platform concept behind this command: [docs.bronto.io/Account-Management/API-Keys](https://docs.bronto.io/Account-Management/API-Keys)
:::

```sh
bronto auth <command> [flags]
```

#### Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`bronto auth login`](/reference/commands/auth/#bronto-auth-login) | Authenticate and store a Bronto API key |
| [`bronto auth logout`](/reference/commands/auth/#bronto-auth-logout) | Remove the stored API key for a profile |
| [`bronto auth status`](/reference/commands/auth/#bronto-auth-status) | Show the resolved profile, credential source, and API reachability |
| [`bronto auth switch`](/reference/commands/auth/#bronto-auth-switch) | Set the default profile |
| [`bronto auth token`](/reference/commands/auth/#bronto-auth-token) | Print the API key in use, for scripts |

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

## bronto auth login

Authenticate and store a Bronto API key

```sh
bronto auth login [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--key-stdin` |  | bool |  | read the API key from stdin instead of prompting |

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

## bronto auth logout

Remove the stored API key for a profile

```sh
bronto auth logout [flags]
```

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

## bronto auth status

Show the resolved profile, credential source, and API reachability

```sh
bronto auth status [flags]
```

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

## bronto auth switch

Set the default profile

```sh
bronto auth switch <profile> [flags]
```

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

## bronto auth token

Print the API key in use, for scripts

```sh
bronto auth token [flags]
```

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

#### Examples

```sh
export BRONTO_API_KEY=$(bronto auth token)
```
